summary: Build interoperable CERNBox storage services, contribute backend/frontend code, support deployments and explore AI features.
requirements: Required: relevant master plus 2–6 years post-graduation experience, or PhD with at most three years post-graduation experience; Go, Linux and interest in frontend/cloud-native development. No previous CERN fellow/graduate contract. English with commitment to learn French.
compensation: CHF 6,372 or CHF 7,004 net per month, depending on degree; allowances may apply.
conditions: Fully onsite in Geneva; 24–36 months, 40 hours weekly. Target start February 2027; deadline 2026-11-29, 23:59 CET. Graduate programme does not mean zero experience. CERN requires nationality of a Member or Associate Member State for this program; Brazil is an Associate Member according to https://home.cern/about/who-we-are/our-stakeholders. This is work in Geneva, not remote from Brazil.
